summary: Jefferies Financial Group Inc. filed a preliminary pricing supplement (424B5) for a public offering of $1,000 par Senior Fixed Rate 20-Year Callable Notes due July 17, 2046. The notes carry a 6.60% annual interest rate and are callable at par on any July 17 from 2028 through 2045. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. Jefferies LLC is the agent. This is an ordinary debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. No special-situation elements are present.
